creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the owner's note (2026-11-19), read back to him and confirmed: Claude Code has a Monitor tool that wakes the agent when a command's output matches; Codex has no such concept. Muster could offer a verb that subscribes an agent to something - a build's exit, a file, another pane's state - and wakes it through the daemon when it happens, for any harness. Related: `report --waiting --until-exits` and `pane wait` cover parts of this. Filed as an idea: the note did not say to build it.
title: A harness-neutral way for an agent to subscribe to something and be woken when it happens
